# opal_request_template (Data Source)

RequestTemplate DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opal_request_template" "my_requesttemplate" {
  request_template_id = "4baf8423-db0a-4037-a4cf-f79c60cb67a5"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `request_template_id` (String) The ID of the request template.

### Read-Only

- `custom_fields` (Attributes List) The fields on this template, in the order they are shown. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_fields))
- `name` (String) The name of the request template.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_fields`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Helper text shown beneath the field.
- `metadata` (Attributes) Extra configuration for field types that need it. Exactly one member is set, and which one is determined by the field's `type`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_fields--metadata))
- `name` (String) The label shown to the requester. `CALLOUT` fields are display-only, so their name is an internal identifier and is never displayed.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the requester must answer. Always false for `CALLOUT` fields, which collect no answer.
- `type` (String) The type of the custom request field. `CALLOUT` fields are display-only -- they show a message to the requester and collect no answer, so they never appear in a request's `custom_fields`.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_fields--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_fields.metadata`

Read-Only:

- `callout_data` (Attributes) The message shown to a requester by a `CALLOUT` field, and how prominently to show it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_fields--metadata--callout_data))
- `multi_choice_data` (Attributes) The options a requester can pick from in a `MULTI_CHOICE` or `MULTI_SELECT` field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_fields--metadata--multi_choice_data))

<a id="nestedatt--custom_fields--metadata--callout_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_fields.metadata.callout_data`

Read-Only:

- `severity` (String) How prominently the message is shown.
- `text` (String) The message shown to the requester.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_fields--metadata--multi_choice_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_fields.metadata.multi_choice_data`

Read-Only:

- `options` (List of String)
